settings.purpose: which model makes the two judgments in this job, naming the concepts and writing the questions. Left unset it is gemini-3.8-flash. Which model wrote somebody's questions is most of what they are worth and most of what they cost, so it is said here rather than held as a constant inside a script where nobody reading this package could find it

set to on to carry a Built by AgentMesh footer at the foot of the quiz page. Absent, or any of off, no, false, 0 and none, and the page carries none, which is what it does by default; anything else the host writes puts the footer on, because a typo must never quietly strip a credit

directories.name: records
directories.purpose: one folder per job, holding the source as received, the reading, the concept list, the quiz and the coverage check
